title: Add x-data-classification metadata to the mongodb-mcp-server tool argument schemas
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server (pinned commit aaa72a04, branch main), create src/tools/mongodb/dataClassification.ts. It exports the approved labels and a helper, withClassification(schema, labels), that calls Zod 4 .meta({"x-data-classification": labels, "x-dpdp-category": "personal-data"}). Apply the helper to zEJSON() in src/tools/args.ts where it backs filter, projection, document and update arguments, to AnyAggregateStage and the vector-search stage schemas in src/tools/mongodb/mongodbSchemas.ts, and to the .passthrough() schemas in src/tools/mongodb/read/find.ts:22 and create/createIndex.ts:164, using the classification from the task 1 map. Keep validation behaviour unchanged, adding metadata only. Release in the releaseProcess order dev -> qa -> prod with 1 approval and a rollback plan. Before promoting to prod (exposure partner), run tools/list and one find call against qa and confirm existing MCP clients accept the schema.
acceptanceCriteria: The tools/list response from a local or qa build shows x-data-classification on the filter, projection, document, update and pipeline arguments of every mongodb/* tool (checked with jq over the JSON output)
pnpm test (vitest unit-and-integration) passes on the PR branch, with no change to accepted or rejected argument shapes in the existing tool tests
A find call through the qa gateway succeeds after deployment, with an unchanged result shape

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-schemas for mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server at the merged commit. Expected: no SCH-PII-01 fail result for src/tools/mongodb/mongodbSchemas.ts, so fingerprint 014e4817400eb27b724472fb10d87ee03186aeab06604ddda8581bfbd41b4b42 is absent from the SARIF export, and the ID.AM.S5 observation for the repo is satisfied.

rootCause.description: The upstream MCP server models tool arguments as opaque EJSON records with prose .describe() hints only; no metadata layer carries the pii/financial classification of the stores the gateway connects to, so masking and access policy cannot key off it.
